scope: Node log delivery during slow snapshot application, ordered acknowledgement and cancellation, with focused upstream Secret-volume verification

rootCause.observedFailure: The completed full-run Secret mappings Pod reached Succeeded but its log request returned HTTP 500 after approximately 10 seconds. Its retained CRI log contains the expected projected data.
rootCause.reproducedCause: The node session synchronously applied snapshots on its receive thread. A blocked runtime creation for another Pod prevented dispatch of a queued log request until the unchanged ten-second operation deadline expired, while heartbeats kept the node Ready.
rootCause.fix: Apply snapshots in order on a session-owned worker; keep message reception responsive and cancel/join application before reconnect.
rootCause.qualification: Raw full-run evidence establishes failed log delivery and successful projection. The deterministic HTTP/gRPC/runtime barrier regression establishes snapshot starvation as a reproducible cause of that same timeout response; the original run did not record thread stack traces.

recoveredCRIOutput.interpretation: Actual output reports mode 0644 and content value-1 at the requested mapped Secret path; this does not convert the failed upstream test into a pass.

workerFailureCancellationRegression.before: Stopping a worker inside its application-error handler produced an uncaught NODE-SNAPSHOT-STOPPED condition. The isolated failed fixture process was intentionally terminated after preserving its diagnostic output.
